title: Identification of phytochemicals as putative ligands for the targeted modulation of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha (PPARalpha) in animals.
authors: Hassan, Faiz-Ul; Rehman, M Saif-Ur; Javed, Maryam; Ahmad, Khalil; Fatima, Israr; Safdar, Muhammad; Ashraf, Noman; Nadeem, Asif
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟筛选植物化学物作为PPARalpha（核受体转录因子）的配体，虽涉及TF-配体互作建模，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题核心偏离。
abstract: The PPAR family of transcription factors are ligand-activated and regulate diverse functions including metabolic, neurological, and inflammatory diseases, neurodegenerative disorders, fertility or reproduction in the body. Specifically, PPARalpha is known to play a role in reducing the levels of circulating triglycerides and regulating energy homeostasis in livestock animals. This study aimed to identify phytochemicals that could serve as ligands for modulation of the bovine nuclear peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha (PPARalpha) using molecular docking studies. Therefore, we investigated 1000 flavonoids belonging to different groups for their ability to bind to PPARalpha using molecular docking. Out of 1000, 6 top lead compounds with maximum binding affinity, evaluated through molecular docking, were further analysed for physicochemical properties and drug-likeness attributes. The results revealed that two flavonoids, Quercetin-3-o-rhamnoside and (-)- epicatechingallate, which are known fatty acid synthase inhibitors, demonstrated high docking scores with PPARalpha (-8.66 kcal/mol and -8.49 kcal/mol, respectively) and low RMSD values with PPARalpha (1.61 kcal/mol and 1.28 kcal/mol, respectively) as compared to PPARalpha agonist (synthetic), fenofibrate (-6.24 kcal/mol and 2.19 kcal/mol) and thus analyzed further for prediction of stability of docked complexes through MD simulations. MD simulation studies predicted the stability of complexes and the complex of Quercetin-3-o-rhamnoside and (-)- epicatechingallate were found to be stable at 100 ns based on RSMD value and RMSF residue index. Through computational analysis, the screened compounds showed good pharmacokinetic parameters, including non-toxicity, non-carcinogenic, high gastrointestinal absorption and thus can serve as potential drug candidates. Finally, the findings suggest that these phytochemicals have the potential to act as potent PPARalpha pharmacological agonists to prevent disease mechanisms and their related complications, providing insights into the role of phytochemicals as feed additives in animals for modulating PPARalpha functions.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: PPAR（过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体）转录因子家族受配体激活，并调节多种功能，包括代谢性疾病、神经系统疾病、炎症性疾病、神经退行性疾病、生育或生殖功能。具体而言，PPARalpha 已知在降低循环甘油三酯水平和调节家畜能量稳态中发挥作用。本研究旨在通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 研究，识别可作为配体以调节牛核过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体 alpha (PPARalpha) 的植物化学物质。因此，我们使用分子对接方法，研究了分属不同类别的1000种类黄酮与PPARalpha的结合能力。在1000种化合物中，通过分子对接评估，筛选出6种具有最大结合亲和力的先导化合物，并进一步分析其理化性质和类药性特征。结果表明，两种类黄酮，即槲皮素-3-O-鼠李糖苷 (Quercetin-3-o-rhamnoside) 和 (-)-表儿茶素没食子酸酯 ((-)-epicatechingallate)，已知为脂肪酸合酶抑制剂，与PPARalpha表现出高对接分数（分别为-8.66 kcal/mol和-8.49 kcal/mol）和低RMSD值（分别为1.61 kcal/mol和1.28 kcal/mol），相较于PPARalpha激动剂（合成）非诺贝特 (fenofibrate)（-6.24 kcal/mol和2.19 kcal/mol），因此进一步通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟分析对接复合物的稳定性。MD模拟研究预测了复合物的稳定性，基于RSMD值和RMSF残基指数，槲皮素-3-O-鼠李糖苷和(-)-表儿茶素没食子酸酯的复合物在100 ns内保持稳定。通过计算分析，筛选出的化合物表现出良好的药代动力学参数，包括无毒性、无致癌性、高胃肠道吸收性，因此可作为潜在候选药物。最后，研究结果表明，这些植物化学物质具有作为强效PPARalpha药理学激动剂的潜力，以预防疾病机制及其相关并发症，为植物化学物质作为动物饲料添加剂以调节PPARalpha功能提供了见解。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
